set.body: Pak rejects neurosurf GitHub HEAD after upstream CRAN preparation resets its version from 0.1.0.9004 to 0.1.0, below neuroatlas minimum >=0.1.0.9002. Verify needed APIs at current upstream revision, accept 0.1.0 and pin that tested revision. Reproduce package-check and website dependency plans, validate surface consumers, and preserve existing transform engine pins.
set.title: Accept and pin neurosurf CRAN-preparation version in CI
